description:
Mo Layer is a secure photo and file organiser for iPhone, built for people who want private content to stay orderly, easy to find and protected from casual browsing. Import photos, videos, IDs, contracts, screenshots, links, receipts, notes and important documents, then keep them in a personal space unlocked with device security and your own private gesture.

Use it to separate personal records from your public camera roll, keep sensitive screenshots away from shared albums, store copies of documents for quick reference, or build a calm archive for memories and files you do not want mixed with everyday media.

Key features:
• Protect photos, videos and files on this device
• Import from Photos, Camera, Files and share extensions
• Organise content with albums, recent imports, favourites and trash recovery
• Quickly find saved items by keeping related memories and documents together
• Optional iCloud encrypted sync for device changes and recovery
• Discreet file-cabinet entry and realistic decoy space for everyday situations
• Pro unlocks unlimited storage, batch organisation, advanced disguise, decoy passcodes, intrusion records and advanced recovery

Privacy is central to Mo Layer. Your personal content stays protected on your device by default. When iCloud sync is enabled, synced content is encrypted before upload, and the developer does not hold your decryption key.
